references.text: Promises of eternal life for the one who believes in God's Son, with a direct parallel to the formulation that the one who believes 'has' eternal life.
The same logic that faith grants immediate possession of eternal life and a transition from death to life, without any waiting period.
Jesus' own declaration that He is the resurrection and the life, and that whoever believes in Him will live even if he dies.
Confirmation that eternal life is given in the Son, and that whoever has the Son has life, emphasizing the security of faith.
The definition of eternal life as knowledge of the true God and Jesus Christ, given to the one who believes.
